nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 1$, the number of $a \in \{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ for which the word $0^a 1 0^{n-1-a}$ ($a$ zeros, then a one, then $n - 1 - a$ zeros) is an Ulam word equals $2^{s_2(n-1)}$, where $s_2(m)$ is the sum of the binary digits of $m$. This number is the term $G(n - 1)$ of Gould's sequence.
nodes.title: Counting Ulam words with a single one

nodes.summary: The stage $S_1$ of the discrete Sierpiński triangle is $\{(2, 1), (3, 1), (3, 2)\}$.
nodes.title: The first stage of the discrete Sierpiński triangle

nodes.summary: The stages $S_n \subseteq \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$ of the discrete Sierpiński triangle are defined by $S_0 = \{(2, 1)\}$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n \cup (S_n + (2^n, 0)) \cup (S_n + (2^n, 2^n))$, where $S + (u, v) = \{(x + u, y + v) : (x, y) \in S\}$ denotes a translate.
nodes.title: Stages of the discrete Sierpiński triangle

nodes.summary: The discrete Sierpiński triangle is the set $\mathcal{S} = \bigcup_{n \ge 0} S_n \subseteq \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$, the union of all the stages $S_n$ of the discrete Sierpiński triangle.
nodes.title: The discrete Sierpiński triangle

nodes.summary: The words $0001$ and $1011$ are Ulam words, while $0011$ and $0110$ are not.
nodes.title: Ulam words of length four: examples

nodes.summary: For a word $w$ over $\{0, 1\}$, let $\bar w$ be its complement (every letter swapped) and let $\pi(w)$ be the integer whose binary expansion is $w$, most significant letter first. If $w$ is an Ulam word of length $n$, then $\bar w$ is an Ulam word and $\pi(\bar w) + \pi(w) = 2^n - 1$. Moreover, for all natural numbers $N$ and $n$ and every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$, the number of Ulam words $w$ of length $n$…
nodes.title: Complement symmetry of Ulam words

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $x$ and $y$ with $1 \le y \le x$, the word $1^y 0^{x-y}$ ($y$ ones followed by $x - y$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $(x, y) = (1, 1)$ or $(x, y)$ belongs to the discrete Sierpiński triangle $\mathcal{S}$.
nodes.title: Ulam words made of ones followed by zeros

nodes.summary: The empty word is not an Ulam word, and both words $0$ and $1$ of length one are Ulam words. The Ulam words of length two are exactly $01$ and $10$, and the Ulam words of length three are exactly $001$, $011$, $100$ and $110$.
nodes.title: Ulam words of length at most three

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 3$, the word $1^3 0^{n-3}$ (three ones followed by $n - 3$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $n \equiv 0 \pmod 4$ or $n \equiv 1 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Ulam words with three leading ones

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$ with $a + b \ge 1$, the word $0^a 10101 0^b$ ($a$ zeros, then $10101$, then $b$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $a$ and $b$ are both even and at least one of $a$ and $b$ is zero.
nodes.title: Padding the word 10101 with zeros

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$ with $a + b \ge 1$, the binary word $0^a 1111 0^b$ ($a$ zeros, then four ones, then $b$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $a + b \equiv 1 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Ulam words with a block of four ones

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$ with $a + b \ge 2$, the binary word $0^a 101 0^b$ ($a$ zeros, then the letters $1, 0, 1$, then $b$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $a + b$ is odd.
nodes.title: Ulam words with one 101 block

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, the binary word $0^a 1 0^b$ ($a$ zeros, then a one, then $b$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if the binomial coefficient $\binom{a + b}{a}$ is odd.
nodes.title: Parity criterion for Ulam words with a single one

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, the binary word $0^a 11 0^b$ ($a$ zeros, then two ones, then $b$ zeros) is an Ulam word if and only if $a + b$ is odd.
nodes.title: Ulam words with a block of two ones

nodes.summary: Ulam words are finite words over the alphabet $\{0, 1\}$, defined by recursion on the length. The empty word is not an Ulam word, and the two words $0$ and $1$ of length $1$ are Ulam words. A word $w$ of length at least $2$ is an Ulam word if and only if there is exactly one way to write $w = uv$ with $u$ and $v$ nonempty, distinct Ulam words.
nodes.title: Ulam words

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 6$, the number of Ulam words of length $n$ is at least $2n + 4$.
nodes.title: Linear lower bound on the number of Ulam words

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let $U_n$ be the set of Ulam words of length $n$, and let $\mu_g(n)$ be the mean gap of the binary values of the words in $U_n$. Then $2^n / |U_n|$ (the reciprocal of the density $|U_n| / 2^n$) and $\mu_g(n)$ have the same order of growth as $n \to \infty$: there are constants $c, C > 0$ such that $c \, \mu_g(n) \le 2^n / |U_n| \le C \, \mu_g(n)$ for all sufficiently large $n$.
nodes.title: The inverse Ulam density has the order of the mean gap

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, read each Ulam word of length $n$ as a binary numeral, most significant letter first, and list the resulting values in increasing order as $u_1 < u_2 < \dots < u_k$. The mean gap of these values is the rational number
nodes.title: Mean gap of the Ulam values

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $N$ and $n$ and a residue $a \in \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$, let $c_{a,N}(n)$ be the number of Ulam words of length $n$ whose value as a binary numeral, most significant letter first, is congruent to $a$ modulo $N$. Then for every $n \ge 1$ we have $c_{0,2}(n) = c_{1,2}(n)$, and for every $a \in \mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z}$ we have $c_{a,3}(n) = c_{-a,3}(n)$ if $n$ is even and…
nodes.title: Residue symmetries of Ulam words modulo 2 and 3

nodes.summary: Read the Ulam words of length $2$ as binary numerals, most significant letter first. None of their values is congruent to $0$ modulo $3$, exactly one is congruent to $1$, and exactly one is congruent to $2$.
nodes.title: Residues of the Ulam words of length 2 modulo 3

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $N$ and $n$ and a residue class $a \in \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$, this is the number of Ulam words $w$ of length $n$ in the letters $0$ and $1$ whose binary value $\pi(w)$, read with the most significant letter first, lies in the class $a$ modulo $N$. For $N = 0$, $\mathbb{Z}/0\mathbb{Z}$ is $\mathbb{Z}$ and the condition is $\pi(w) = a$.
nodes.title: Ulam words in a residue class

nodes.summary: The increasing list of the distinct binary values $\pi(w)$, read with the most significant letter first, of the Ulam words $w$ of length $3$ has exactly the entries $1, 3, 4, 6$.
nodes.title: Binary values of the Ulam words of length 3

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the list $u_1 < u_2 < \dots < u_k$ of the distinct binary values $\pi(w)$, read with the most significant letter first, of the Ulam words $w$ of length $n$, in increasing order.
nodes.title: Sorted binary values of Ulam words

nodes.summary: For a natural number $f$ (the fuel) and a word $w$ in the letters $0$ and $1$, the test returns false when $f = 0$. With fuel $f + 1$ it returns true when $w$ has length $1$; otherwise it returns true exactly when there is exactly one $k$ with $1 \le k < |w|$ such that the prefix $w_1 \cdots w_k$ and the suffix $w_{k+1} \cdots w_{|w|}$ are distinct and both pass the test with fuel $f$.
nodes.title: Fuel-bounded Ulam test

nodes.summary: Let $\#U_n$ be the number of Ulam words of length $n$ and $\alpha_0 = (\#U_{30} / (2 \cdot 31))^{1/30}$. For every real $\alpha$ with $1 < \alpha < \alpha_0$, every real $C$ and every natural number $N$, there is some $n \ge N$ with $C \alpha^n \le \#U_n$; that is, $\limsup_{n \to \infty} \#U_n / \alpha^n = \infty$.
nodes.title: Exponential lower bound for Ulam word counts along a subsequence

nodes.summary: There are $2$, $2$, $4$ and $8$ Ulam words of length $1$, $2$, $3$ and $4$ respectively: $\#U_1 = 2$, $\#U_2 = 2$, $\#U_3 = 4$ and $\#U_4 = 8$, where $\#U_n$ is the number of Ulam words of length $n$.
nodes.title: Numbers of short Ulam words

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, $(\#U_n)^2 \le \sum_{i=n}^{2n} \#U_i$, where $\#U_i$ is the number of Ulam words of length $i$.
nodes.title: Square of the Ulam word count is at most a block sum

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\#U_n$ denotes the number of Ulam words of length $n$, that is, of words $w_1 \cdots w_n$ of length $n$ in the letters $0$ and $1$ that are Ulam words.
nodes.title: Number of Ulam words of a given length

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
